prompt_en: Create a photorealistic environmental fashion editorial at the terraced salt pans of Maras, Peru, immediately after a mountain sunshower. One unmistakably adult woman, using the supplied reference image only as visible appearance guidance, balances on a narrow ochre service ledge while pouring a copper bowl of brine into the next pool; the suspended stream arcs through the frame as wind drives sparkling droplets sideways. A vertical front-three-quarter full figure keeps both waist cutouts and the pouring action visible. Her single-piece opaque dress has paired lateral waist skin openings, one slightly forward of each side seam so both show together. Each is a physical hole through opaque fabric with exposed skin inside and its own complete, closed, finished perimeter of crisp sewn edges. An opaque central front panel continuously bridges bodice to skirt across the waist. Opaque nontransparent fabric securely covers her breasts and pelvis; the two waist openings alone supply exposure. Even fill light and arms held clear show the uninterrupted one-piece construction, central bridge, and both stitched perimeters. Stepped salt pools reflect rain light around the copper brine stream.
